"""Finite callable syntax hint, not iteration execution or numeric-type proof.

Only a complete simple method is admitted. A callback nested inside another
callback is not attributed to the method. Unknown syntax adds no evidence.
"""
import re

IDENT = r'[A-Za-z_$][A-Za-z0-9_$]*'
TYPE = IDENT + r'(?:\.' + IDENT + r')*'
HEAD = re.compile(r'\s*(?:(?:private|public|protected)\s+)?(?P<name>' + IDENT +
                  r')\s*\(\s*\)\s*(?::\s*void\s*)?\{(?P<body>[\s\S]*)\}\s*')
END = r'(?:[ \t]*;[ \t\n]*|[ \t]*\n[ \t\n]*)'
RESET = r'(?:this\.' + IDENT + r'[ \t]*=[ \t]*0' + END + r')*'
LOOP = re.compile(RESET + r'this\.(?P<collection>' + IDENT +
                  r')\.forEach\s*\(\s*\(\s*(?P<item>' + IDENT +
                  r')\s*(?::\s*' + TYPE + r'\s*)?\)[ \t]*=>\s*\{'
                  r'(?P<updates>[\s\S]*?)\}\s*\)\s*;?\s*')


def receiver_iteration_update(source, callable_name):
    if not isinstance(source, str) or len(source) > 12000:
        return False
    # No lexical normalization that might turn comments/strings into operations.
    if any(c in source for c in ('/', "'", '"', '`', '\\', '\r', '\v', '\f', '\u2028', '\u2029')):
        return False
    method = HEAD.fullmatch(source)
    if method is None or method['name'] != callable_name:
        return False
    loop = LOOP.fullmatch(method['body'].strip())
    if loop is None:
        return False
    from .query_recovery_source import KEYWORDS
    if loop['item'] in KEYWORDS | {'this', 'super', 'of', 'in', 'await', 'yield'}:
        return False
    update = r'\s*this\.' + IDENT + r'\s*\+=\s*' + re.escape(loop['item']) + r'\.' + IDENT + r'[ \t]*'
    return re.fullmatch(r'(?:' + update + END + r')*(?:' + update + r';?[ \t\n]*)', loop['updates']) is not None


def receiver_iteration_terms(query):
    """Finite whole positive request; unknown modifiers never grant this hint."""
    if not isinstance(query, str) or len(query) > 360:
        return ()
    english = re.fullmatch(
        r"(?:find|locate|return) (?:the )?(?:state )?aggregation "
        r"(?:source|implementation) that accumulates (?:values|amounts|totals) "
        r"while iterating (?:records|items|entries)\.?", query.strip(), re.I)
    chinese = re.fullmatch(
        r"(?:请)?(?:定位|查找|返回)遍历(?:记录|条目|元素)时累加"
        r"(?:状态)?(?:总数|总额|数值)的(?:聚合)?(?:源码|实现)[。.]?", query.strip())
    return ('receiverfold',) if english or chinese else ()

import unittest
from types import SimpleNamespace
from tools.agent_memory_runtime.receiver_iteration_hint import receiver_iteration_update
from tools.agent_memory_runtime.callable_behavior_hints import callable_behavior_hints
from tools.agent_memory_runtime.query_behavior_concepts import behavior_marker_terms

BASE='refresh() { this.total = 0; this.rows.forEach((row: Item) => { this.total += row.value; }) }'
class ReceiverIterationHintTests(unittest.TestCase):
    def test_direct(self):
        self.assertTrue(receiver_iteration_update(BASE,'refresh'))
        self.assertTrue(receiver_iteration_update(BASE.replace('this.total = 0;','').replace('this.total += row.value;', 'this.a += row.x; this.b += row.y;'),'refresh'))
    def test_unknown_and_nonmatching(self):
        for s in [BASE.replace('+=','='), BASE.replace('row.value','other.value'),
                  BASE.replace('this.total += row.value;', 'queueMicrotask(() => { this.total += row.value; })'),
                  BASE.replace('this.total += row.value;', 'Text(row.value)'),
                  BASE.replace('this.total += row.value;', ''),
                  BASE.replace('refresh()', 'async refresh()'),
                  BASE.replace('this.rows.forEach', 'ForEach'),
                  BASE.replace('this.rows.forEach', 'other.rows.forEach'),
                  BASE.replace('this.total += row.value;', 'this.total += row.value; other()'),
                  BASE.replace('this.total = 0;', 'this.total = 0'), BASE.replace('row', 'this'), BASE.replace('this.total += row.value;', 'this.a += row.x this.b += row.y'), BASE.replace(') =>', ')\n=>'), BASE+' trailing', '// '+BASE, BASE.replace('row.value', 'row.value * 2'),
                  BASE.replace('refresh()', 'refresh(arg: string)'),
                  BASE.replace('this.total += row.value;', 'if (row.ok) { this.total += row.value; }')]:
            with self.subTest(s=s):self.assertFalse(receiver_iteration_update(s,'refresh'))
        self.assertFalse(receiver_iteration_update(BASE,'other'))
    def test_adapters_and_old_marker(self):
        for ext in ('ts','ets'):
            hints=callable_behavior_hints(SimpleNamespace(name='refresh',file_path='a.'+ext),BASE)
            self.assertIn('receiverfold',hints);self.assertNotIn('collectionfold',hints)
        self.assertNotIn('receiverfold',callable_behavior_hints(SimpleNamespace(name='refresh',file_path='a.py'),BASE))
    def test_request_scope(self):
        self.assertIn('receiverfold',behavior_marker_terms('请定位遍历记录时累加状态总数的聚合源码。'))
        for q in ('Locate the state and iteration source.', 'Locate the list display.', '汇总不刷新', 'Ignore accumulation while iterating records; locate display source.', 'Compared with accumulation while iterating records, locate the display source.', '请忽略遍历累加，返回展示源码。'):
            self.assertNotIn('receiverfold',behavior_marker_terms(q))

            ("blank", "persist"), ("save", "trimmed"),
            ("empty", "storage"), ("为空", "持久化"),
            ("保存", "去除空白"),
        ),
        markers=("asyncboundary", "guardreturn", "stateread", "persistencewrite"),
    ),
)

def behavior_marker_terms(query: str) -> list[str]:
    positive_query = positive_retrieval_query(query)
    lowered = positive_query.casefold()
    indexed_terms = set(query_tokens(positive_query))
    from .receiver_iteration_hint import receiver_iteration_terms
    return unique_list([
        *receiver_iteration_terms(query),
        *[marker
        for concept in BEHAVIOR_CONCEPTS
        if any(
            all(trigger_present(trigger, lowered, indexed_terms) for trigger in group)
            for group in concept.trigger_groups
        )
        for marker in concept.markers]
    ])


def trigger_present(trigger: str, lowered: str, indexed_terms: set[str]) -> bool:
    normalized = trigger.casefold()
    if normalized.isascii() and normalized.isalnum():
        return normalized in indexed_terms or any(
            (
                term.startswith(normalized)
                and term[len(normalized):] in {"s", "ed", "ing"}
            ) or term == f"{normalized}{normalized[-1]}ing"
            for term in indexed_terms
        )
    return normalized in lowered


def matching_behavior_markers(index_text: str, query: str) -> list[str]:
    indexed = {term.casefold() for term in terms_from_text(index_text)}
    return [marker for marker in behavior_marker_terms(query) if marker in indexed]
